dataset: NHANES 2015-2016 complete-case adults with HbA1c, FPG, and 2-h OGTT

inference.primary_descriptive_unit: outer fold, summarized with repeat-level uncertainty
inference.paired_test_1: exact Wilcoxon on five repeat-level means
inference.paired_test_2: Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t-test on 25 paired fold differences
inference.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment across 10 canonical metric-comparison tests
